notes.title: ILLWILL Update 1.10
notes.content:
Dear friends. Thanks to everyone who supported me by buying the game. I have a New Year's gift for you. I thought, what kind of boomer shooter is there now without the dash mechanics and made a dash in ILLWILL. It seems to me that it plays much more cheerfully and dynamically.

[previewyoutube=8BPWUYDK53E;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] Added dash mechanics (I didn't change the locations and now you can dash into places you shouldn't go. Promise me that you won't abuse the game)
[*] Added cheat menu (type on numpad 17930 to open)
[*] Cosmetic weapon improvements
[/list]

[b]Warning![/b]
[i]By default, the dash works on the left shift, or the B button on the gamepad. If you have changed the controls before, you may need to bind these buttons again through the menu.
If the dash does not work on the gamepad. You need to delete the config file, which is located:

C:\Users\YourUserName\AppData\Local\ILLWILL\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor\Input.ini

The game will create a new config when launched and everything will work.[/i]

Happy New Year!

notes.title: ILLWILL Patch 1.09
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved low settings
[*] Enemies models optimization
[*] Improved visual readability of weapon items
[*] Added a light source to the Butcher's projectile and the Painhead's head
[*] Added light sources to bullet impacts
[/list]

I was never happy with how the game looked on super low settings. Now I like it, but the system requirements have grown. If you are someone who played ILLWILL on a Pentium and now the game is slowing down for you, please write about it on the forum.

P.S.
Painheads hates EVERYONE!

notes.title: ILLWILL Patch 1.085
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved game stability
[*] Fixed a bug with the shot getting jam
[*] Added the ability to turn on the flashlight yourself
[/list]

The game now runs on the latest engine version 4.27. If you find any bugs, please write about it on the forum.
Many people told me that the game was quite dark, so I decided to add the ability to turn on the flashlight at any time. This did not affect the main functionality of the flashlight, it will also turn on automatically in dark places, as before.

If you have installed the game previously, you may need to bind the flashlight button manually, most likely due to a config conflict.

tags.feature: [*] Added the ability to turn on the flashlight yourself

notes.title: ILLWILL
notes.content:
I'm happy to introduce you to a feature that I've been working on for the past few months. 
These are game mods!
After beating the game, you will see a menu in which you can select one of the three modification.

[h2]Double Spawn[/h2]
In this modification, enemies will spawn 2 times more! More enemies, more challenge, more gore!

[h2]Lasergun Mastery[/h2]
Only one weapon will be available to you - the laser gun. By collecting ammo on the level, you will receive random upgrades that open up an alternative shooting mode. 
There are five upgrades in total:
[list]
[*] Plasma Bombs
[*] Spazer
[*] Blaster
[*] Homing Spheres
[*] Gravity Core (imba)
[/list]
[h2]Painhead world[/h2]
In this modification, all enemies in the game turn into Painheads. Also, Painheads explosions will one-shot the player.
A serious challenge for you.

Modifications will be available immediately on the release of the game.

GG
GL
